0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000010_ALISAIE
0.description: I'm glad you've come, though I'm afraid there's little in the way of good news.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000020_ALISAIE
1.description: After you left, we reached out to both the Alchemists' Guild and Stillglade Fane, and attempted all manner of treatments...

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000030_ALISAIE
2.description: But the results were always the same. Whatever the answer is, it's not alchemy or conjury...

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000040_ALISAIE
3.description: Why did it have to be Y'shtola and Urianger, and not me? Out of all of us, they are the ones who could feasibly have solved this puzzle.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000050_ALISAIE
4.description: And Alphinaud's still missing. Gods, it's all going wrong... Where do we even start?

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000060_KRILE
5.description: (-???-)A grave situation, indeed. Might I be of some assistance?

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000070_ALISAIE
6.description: Krile! I thought you busy delving into the mysteries of Eureka...

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000080_ALISAIE
7.description: Krile! I did not think you well enough to travel...

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000090_KRILE
8.description: When word reached me of the plight of our friends, I could not well stay away. As a fellow Scion, not to mention your erstwhile mentor, this is one of those times you should feel free to call on me─regardless of my personal circumstances.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000100_ALISAIE
9.description: I... Yes, I should have thought of that.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000110_ALISAIE
10.description: Thank you for coming, Krile. We would welcome your insight.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000120_KRILE
11.description: And I should be happy to provide it. Now, what's this I hear about Alphinaud heading into imperial territory? That boy always did have some funny ideas. Do you remember the speech he gave when he was accepted to the Studium?

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000130_ALISAIE
12.description: “My life's goal is naught less than the salvation of this star!”

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000160_KRILE
15.description: That particular grand pronouncement has been a source of great embarrassment to him, as you know. But the fact of the matter is, he meant every word, and has lived his life accordingly.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000170_ALISAIE
16.description: Yes, he remains altruistic to a fault. But I'm worried he was too fixated on his goals to see the dangers, as has happened before...

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000180_KRILE
17.description: You needn't be so concerned. Though his values remain the same, Alphinaud is not the blinkered boy he once was. Slowly but surely, his eyes have been opened─thanks to a certain someone.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000190_KRILE
18.description: A certain someone whom he'd be mortified to learn had heard about his little speech. Mum's the word, eh?

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000200_KRILE
19.description: Right, I had better have a look at our patients. They're in the infirmary, I assume? I'll need absolute quiet, so it would be best if I did this alone. If you'll excuse me...

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000210_KRILE
20.description: All three are in fine physical health. At a glance, I would say they were merely sound asleep...

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000220_KRILE
21.description: ...Except for the fact that I couldn't sense the slightest trace of “them” in their bodies. It's as if their souls have taken leave of their physical forms.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000230_ALISAIE
22.description: Ah. Yes. The Elder Seedseer made a similar observation.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000240_KRILE
23.description: I've read the report. When you heard this mysterious voice, you described feeling as if you were “somewhere else,” yes?

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000250_KRILE
24.description: If we assume the aether which comprises your essence is being drawn to some other place...

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000260_KRILE
25.description: Then it may be possible to follow the trail it leaves behind, just as we did in our search for Thancred.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000270_ALISAIE
26.description: I wasn't around for that. But I can't imagine it was easy.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000280_KRILE
27.description: Oh, it wasn't. But that's no reason not to try. I will have need of Master Matoya's Crystal Eye if I'm even to make the attempt, so I suggest we pay her a visit.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000290_MATOYA
28.description: Come to disturb my peace again, have you? I hide myself away in a cave, and <hex:021A020203>still<hex:021A020103> you people insist on pestering me with your problems.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000300_MATOYA
29.description: Oh. I mistook you for young what's-his-name, but I see now you're the sister. Weren't you supposed to be the lively one? I've seen happier faces at a rain-sodden burial.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000310_ALISAIE
30.description: Well, I'm sorry to dash your expectations, but the situation isn't exactly conducive to gaiety.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000320_MATOYA
31.description: Ah, that's more like it. Shtola used to spit and hiss like a wildcat, too. Better for a young thing like you to be filled with fire, and leave the doom and gloom to your elders.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000330_MATOYA
32.description: Now, what exactly does this tragic situation of yours have to do with me?

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000340_KRILE
33.description: If I may, Master Matoya, we have need of your Crystal Eye once more...

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000350_MATOYA
34.description: And Shtola is one of the afflicted, is she?

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000360_MATOYA
35.description: Very well. She may be an ungrateful stray, but she's <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> ungrateful stray. And I'll not see her buried before I am.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000370_KRILE
36.description: Right. Let us see what we can see.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000380_KRILE
37.description: I'll begin from where our friends first fell, and cast my senses out from there...

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000390_ALISAIE
38.description: ...What is it? Did you find them!?

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000400_KRILE
39.description: Th-This doesn't make sense. How is it even possible...?

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000410_ALISAIE
40.description: How is <hex:021A020203>what<hex:021A020103> possible!? Krile, what did you see!?

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000420_KRILE
41.description: Th-The threads, they just...they just ended. And, no, I didn't lose track of them─I followed them as far as they went. It's as if─ It's as if they were cut off.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000430_ALISAIE
42.description: Could their aether have dissipated? If it had─ Oh gods...

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000440_ALISAIE
43.description: Their bodies are just husks. It's like the broodmother's daughter all over again...

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000450_KRILE
44.description: No, no, this is different. The Qalyana girl was already dead, body and soul, when Lakshmi effected her resurrection.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000460_MATOYA
45.description: Aye, let's not jump to conclusions. If their physical forms yet breathe and show no signs of wasting, then it follows that their souls must still be intact somewhere.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000480_MATOYA
47.description: That's the question, isn't it, girl? Death has not taken them to the aetherial sea, yet there are no tracks left for us to follow.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000490_ALISAIE
48.description: We're no closer to an answer than when we started. But knowing their souls are still out there is progress of a sort. We just have to keep looking.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000510_ALISAIE
50.description: Yes? ...I remember, but─ ...What, to <hex:021A020203>Ala Mhigo<hex:021A020103>!? We're on our way!

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000520_ALISAIE
51.description: That was Lyse. Apparently, a group of Populares have defected to Ala Mhigo, and Maxima─the envoy Alphinaud left with─is one of them!

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000530_ALISAIE
52.description: I'm sorry, I realize we've barely begun here, but...

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000540_MATOYA
53.description: Go, child, go. You've made up your mind, and life's too short for dithering.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000550_KRILE
54.description: I'll do some digging in the meantime, and see if there isn't some other method we could use to continue the search.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000570_MATOYA
56.description: Bah, not again... The enchantment barely seems to take, these days. I'd chalk it up to old age, but I rather doubt it's that simple.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000580_ALISAIE
57.description: Before they...took ill, Y'shtola and Urianger were sharing notes on a “thinning” of the aether. It seems to be happening all over.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000590_MATOYA
58.description: Does it now? And here I was, all set to blame my woes on that creaking mountain of refuse clogging up the Thaliak.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000600_MATOYA
59.description: I fear something has gone awry. Still, there's naught to be gained from starting at shadows. You can only do what can be done, and that but one thing at a time!

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000610_LYSE
60.description: I'm sorry to drag you halfway across the realm, but when Maxima mentioned Alphinaud, I thought you'd want to hear the news in person.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000620_MAXIMA
61.description: Ah, we meet again...though I was hoping our reunion would be under more auspicious circumstances.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000630_ALISAIE
62.description: What happened to my brother? Where is Alphinaud?

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000640_MAXIMA
63.description: Never fear, my lady. Your brother was in fine health when I took my leave of him, and I have no reason to assume that has changed.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000660_MAXIMA
65.description: If you will allow me, I shall endeavor to explain events.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000670_MAXIMA
66.description: Our troubles began not long after we departed Doma. While crossing the Burn, we were fired upon by the Emperor's personal guard, and forced to make an emergency landing.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000680_MAXIMA
67.description: As we stumbled from the wreckage, our attackers fell upon us again, and we would have perished there and then were it not for the intercession of a third party... A band of mercenaries whose leader claimed to pursue a vendetta against the Ascians.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000690_MAXIMA
68.description: This “Shadowhunter,” as he styled himself, then escorted us out of the wastes to relative safety.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000700_MAXIMA
69.description: Upon arriving back in civilization, I gathered my Populares colleagues and prepared to flee the Empire. Master Alphinaud, however, declined the invitation to join us, preferring to continue his investigation into the Ascian threat.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000710_ALISAIE
70.description: Well...at least he's not lying in a heap in the Burn.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000720_ALISAIE
71.description: Tell us more about these Ascian hunters. Who are they? And is Alphinaud still with them?

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000730_MAXIMA
72.description: He is. As to who they are, I am afraid I have nothing to tell you. Beyond the fact that they root out and destroy Ascians, they were unwilling to divulge anything which might serve to identify them.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000740_MAXIMA
73.description: They would not even reveal their next destination...but Master Alphinaud asked to accompany them all the same.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000750_MAXIMA
74.description: Since parting company with your brother, we've been engaged in a game of cat and mouse with the Emperor's guard. We made our way through province after province, finding the army busy “restoring order” wherever we went, until we finally arrived here in Ala Mhigo. I cannot thank Commander Aldynn enough for giving us such an unexpectedly warm welcome.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000760_RAUBAHN
75.description: I'm not inclined to turn away refugees, no matter which land they call home. And if they can tell me how things lie in Garlemald...all the better.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000770_MAXIMA
76.description: On that subject, there is much I would tell you. During the course of our journey, we heard tales that an entire rebel army had been slaughtered in the space of a single night.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000780_MAXIMA
77.description: It would seem my former comrades grew tired of putting down uprisings in the conventional manner, and chose instead to bring a formidable new weapon to bear. Details were sparse, but the rumor alone was enough to dampen the flames of rebellion.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000790_MAXIMA
78.description: I have also heard reports that several companies have withdrawn from their designated provinces and begun marching westward. It is my assessment that the Empire's forces are mobilizing for a large-scale military engagement.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000800_LYSE
79.description: Westward? You mean they're getting ready to invade Ala Mhigo!?

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000810_RAUBAHN
80.description: We knew this was coming. But not that it would be so soon.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000820_LYSE
81.description: We've barely even begun to shore up our defenses! They won't stop an invading army!

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000840_RAUBAHN
83.description: Dispatch messengers to the Alliance leadership requesting reinforcements. And send word to our officers in the field to hasten completion of those border fortifications. Prepare to meet the imperials head-on!

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000850_RAUBAHN
84.description: No matter how quickly we act, we still want for time. When the enemy comes into view, our best recourse will be to open negotiations with their commander, and see that the ensuing proceedings take as long as possible.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000860_LYSE
85.description: Would you and Alisaie head to Doma and let Lord Hien know about this? I'm sure he'll want to hear about Alphinaud too.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000870_ALISAIE
86.description: Consider it done. We'll send word when─

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000900_MYSTERYVOICE
89.description: Eon become instant. Throw wide the gates.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000920_ALISAIE
91.description: Well, at least we're both still standing.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000930_LYSE
92.description: Oh, thank the gods─I thought we'd lost you for a moment there. Why does this keep happening!?

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000940_ALISAIE
93.description: I wish I knew. Nothing we've tried has brought us any closer to an answer...

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000950_ALISAIE
94.description: We'll keep working on it, but first we need to go and see Lord Hien.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000960_HIEN
95.description: It seems the engineers have matters well in hand.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000970_HIEN
96.description: Should the barrier work as we intend, Doma will be free to reinforce her allies in Ala Mhigo without fear of weakening her own borders.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000980_HIEN
97.description: Honored friends, the time has come to put your hard work to the test! Start the generator!

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_000990_IRONWORKSENGINEER04500
98.description: Node one is operational. Nodes two to eight are reporting similar energy levels. The barrier is forming!

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001000_IRONWORKSENGINEER04500
99.description: ...One thousand yalms. Two thousand. Three thousand. Expansion remains smooth. No fluctuations detected.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001010_IRONWORKSENGINEER04500
100.description: ...Four thousand. Five thousand! Target altitude reached! The barrier is holding steady at five thousand yalms! We've done it!

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001020_ALISAIE
101.description: ...Is that an imperial airship? Of all the rotten timing...

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001030_HIEN
102.description: But this is a gift, Mistress Alisaie. They can test our new wall for us!

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001040_HIEN
103.description: Seems solid enough. Though I was hoping for a fireball.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001060_ALISAIE
105.description: What are you─ Let me go! He has my brother!

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001080_SHADOWHUNTER
107.description: (-Shadowhunter-)Be at ease, girl. The lad is not dead─merely locked in slumber.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001100_SHADOWHUNTER
109.description: (-Shadowhunter-)We could identify no cause and found no remedy. Thus I sought to return him to Doma─and into the arms of Lord Hien himself, it would seem.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001110_SHADOWHUNTER
110.description: (-Shadowhunter-)It is a day for fated reunions...

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001120_SHADOWHUNTER
111.description: (-Shadowhunter-)Would you not agree, adventurer? Or should I address you as the “Warrior of Light”?

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001130_SHADOWHUNTER
115.description: Aye. Gaius van Baelsar, the Black Wolf. That was the title I was given. One I have long since relinquished.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001140_SHADOWHUNTER
116.description: Stand down. The legatus of the XIVth Imperial Legion died in Castrum Meridianum. I am no more than Gaius Baelsar, a man without rank or allegiance.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001150_ALISAIE
117.description: Impossible! There's no way you could have survived!

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001160_SHADOWHUNTER
118.description: Do you remember how it unfolded?

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001170_SHADOWHUNTER
119.description: How I was deceived by Lahabrea? How I was convinced that reviving the Ultima Weapon would allow me to bring peace to Eorzea?

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001180_SHADOWHUNTER
120.description: The Ascian used me, as he used so many others─all to further the restoration of his wretched god.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001190_SHADOWHUNTER
121.description: Yet even with the might of Allag at my command, you bested me. And as the Praetorium went up in flames, I was content to burn along with it...for a moment, at least.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001200_SHADOWHUNTER
122.description: A moment of folly. To surrender my life thus would have been to betray all who died for my cause. It was for them that I dragged myself free of the rubble, and swore vengeance on the Ascians.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001210_SHADOWHUNTER
123.description: The Black Wolf has shed his pelt, never to return to Garlemald or her legions. I live now only to exact revenge.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001220_SHADOWHUNTER
124.description: My principle quarry was to be Lahabrea, whom I gather you have since ushered unto oblivion.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001230_SHADOWHUNTER
125.description: But so many more remain. Long has their kind lurked in the shadows, laboring to sow chaos throughout our world. I would see each and every one dragged into the light and put to the sword.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001240_SHADOWHUNTER
126.description: Are the Scions not of like mind?

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001260_SHADOWHUNTER
128.description: Then I shall continue the partnership the boy began, and share what intelligence I have acquired.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001270_SHADOWHUNTER
129.description: Among the Ascians, the black-masked ilk are subordinate to those who wear red. This, you already know.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001280_SHADOWHUNTER
130.description: Yet among the red there exists a hierarchy. Those set adrift with the shards clearly stand below those still joined to the Source.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001290_SHADOWHUNTER
131.description: Nabriales, who once dared to intrude upon the Rising Stones, belonged to the former group. And while he was indeed a dangerous foe, his powers were inconsequential next to the Paragons of the Source.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001300_SHADOWHUNTER
132.description: The first was Lahabrea, who plagues us no more. There is also the white-robed Elidibus; and the elusive Emet-Selch, about whom little is known.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001310_ALISAIE
133.description: We have files on Lahabrea and Elidibus, but I believe this “Emet-Selch” is new to us...?

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001320_ALISAIE
134.description: As I assume my brother told you, we have evidence to suggest that an Ascian now walks in the body of the crown prince. Have you identified this interloper?

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001330_SHADOWHUNTER
135.description: Elidibus seems the most likely culprit. As “emissary,” it is his role to maintain the equilibrium between Darkness and Light.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001340_SHADOWHUNTER
136.description: Your many deeds in Hydaelyn's name have upset the balance, and I believe he seeks to restore it by throwing his considerable power behind the Empire. As a leader of the Ascians, he is one of our primary targets.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001350_SHADOWHUNTER
137.description: It was on the trail of this very prey that the boy and I came across the scene of a failed uprising. In the absence of a single Garlean casualty, we inspected the bodies of the rebels, and the lack of any external injury drew my immediate attention.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001360_SHADOWHUNTER
138.description: They had been slain by Black Rose─an alchemical invention of the imperial army. When I yet served as legatus, I ordered its production halted and all stockpiles destroyed. Toxic gas is not a tool of conquest, but of extermination.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001370_ALISAIE
139.description: Toxic gas!? This must be the new weapon Maxima warned us about─something deadly enough to sweep away all resistance in a matter of hours.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001380_ALISAIE
140.description: Gods, you don't think they're planning to use this in Ala Mhigo, do you?

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001390_SHADOWHUNTER
141.description: Put your fears to rest. We infiltrated the production facility, and destroyed all existing stores of the chemical along with the plant itself. Even should they rebuild the operation, they will not soon manufacture another batch.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001400_SHADOWHUNTER
142.description: Regardless, I would draw your attention to a directive we discovered in the plant's records. The document was marked with a recent date, and authorized with the signature of one Zenos yae Galvus.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001410_HIEN
143.description: A dead man signing the death warrant for thousands. 'Tis bad comedy.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001420_SHADOWHUNTER
144.description: But the tale does not end there─within that same facility was a chamber filled with devices of Allagan design. Cloning technology, we realized.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001430_SHADOWHUNTER
145.description: And what should we find in each and every incubator...but a young Emperor Solus.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001440_SHADOWHUNTER
146.description: ...All of which prompts the question: were the Ascians responsible for these abominations? Or was it the will of the Emperor?

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001450_SHADOWHUNTER
147.description: I must know which hand guides the Empire. Though I have given up my rank, I am yet a son of Garlemald...and I will fight for the future of my homeland.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001460_SHADOWHUNTER
148.description: It is time I returned to the hunting of shadows. We should focus on our common foe─to reopen old quarrels now would serve no purpose.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001470_ALISAIE
149.description: You saved my brother's life, so I'm willing to let sleeping dogs lie. But in truth, it's not my decision to make.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
151.description: You're right. There are more important matters at hand.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001480_SHADOWHUNTER
153.description: There was a time when I scorned those who placed their faith in false gods─even as I, in my blinkered conviction, placed mine in Ascian promises.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001490_SHADOWHUNTER
154.description: Unlike yours, my strength of will─and my restraint─was found wanting. We shall meet again, Warrior of Light.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001500_HIEN
155.description: So that was the infamous Black Wolf. An unexpected ally, to say the least...

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001510_HIEN
156.description: Well, I am content to leave the fine-tuning of the barrier to cleverer minds. Let us bid our friends from the Ironworks farewell and see what can be done for Alphinaud back in Doma.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001520_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
157.description: Meanwhile, at the Black Rose chemical plant...

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001530_IMPERIALENGINEER
158.description: Our supplies of Black Rose have been ruined, but the new plant is already under construction. We should have the first batch ready in time for the offensive, Your Radiance!

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001550_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
160.description: Ah, yes! The infamous “Black Rose.” If I recall correctly, Gaius did not much care for the invention.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001560_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
161.description: A ruthless and indiscriminate weapon indeed, this airborne poison. It seems you <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> capable of making decisions worthy of your bloodline.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001570_VARIS
162.description: With no gift for sorcery, we Garleans must look to magitek to even the odds. If it spares the needless deaths of our soldiers, and serves the cause of this empire, there is no method I would not employ.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001590_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
164.description: Truly, though, I must commend you for embracing your role as emperor. You play the part of the determined ruler well. Sometimes, even <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> catch myself believing!

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001600_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
165.description: A silent agent of death... Now that I think on it, Black Rose may well possess the perfect aspect.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001610_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
166.description: Slowly but surely, the deluge of Light has worked upon the aether here in the Source, and the gas should be most susceptible to its influence...

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001620_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
167.description: Well, I shall leave you to your own devices. Go forth and bloody the land with your grand and glorious war.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001640_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
169.description: Need you ask? I will be doing what all Ascians do.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001650_VARIS
170.description: I am well aware that your kind exists only to usher in the next calamity. But you seem oblivious to the harm your singular agenda causes to the Empire.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001660_VARIS
171.description: You cannot have forgotten the events which followed your mortal demise.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001670_VARIS
172.description: Our homeland was plunged into civil war for your failure to name a successor. The edifice you so carefully constructed was but a hair's breadth from collapse!

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001690_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
174.description: You thought me oblivious to the consequences? Of a departure so painstakingly timed?

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001710_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
176.description: Well, of course it was! Though I will admit the resulting panic exceeded even my wildest expectations. But how can you be surprised? Throwing the world into disarray was the very purpose for which this nation was, as you say, “so carefully constructed.”

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001720_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
177.description: Now, if you have no further questions, I must be on my way.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001730_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
178.description: Since we may not meet again in this lifetime, it would be remiss of me not to offer a word or two of gratitude.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001740_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
179.description: I really must thank you for this surplus of vessels. I can mold any host into my own image, but having bodies tailor-made for me in this fashion is so much less tiresome!

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001750_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
180.description: You dabbled in Allagan cloning techniques, yes? It certainly is a compelling─not to mention entertaining─field of research.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001760_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
181.description: And of all the options available, you chose the founding father on whom to experiment! You have a twisted streak to you, Varis. Like grandsire, like grandson, eh?

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001770_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
182.description: If events play out as planned, this will become something of a family enterprise.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001780_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
183.description: You will be the capstone of this world; I, the anchor in the shard. And together, we will give the lie to this star's fraudulent existence!

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001800_LYSE
187.description: Welcome back, you two. Greetings, Lord Hien! Glad you could join us!

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001810_HIEN
188.description: Glad to be here. I would have come sooner, were our own defenses not in question. But I am pleased to report that our soldiers are assembling for deployment to Ala Mhigo as we speak.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001820_RAUBAHN
189.description: We are grateful for your support. Thanks to the efforts of our allies, it won't be long before we've established defensive positions on this front as well.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001830_ALISAIE
190.description: Ahem, we have some good news too... Alphinaud has come back to us. As for the bad news...

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001840_LYSE
191.description: So, Alphinaud won't wake up, Gaius van Baelsar is alive and hunting Ascians, and the Empire is planning to poison us all with toxic gas. Does that sound about right?

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001850_LYSE
192.description: Ordinarily, any one of those things would have left me in shock, but the way things have been lately, it's all starting to seem pretty normal.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001860_LYSE
193.description: Getting back to your report, are we sure this “Black Rose” is the weapon Maxima was talking about?

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001870_RAUBAHN
194.description: It fits the description. And it seems we have Alphinaud to thank for sparing us an early demonstration of its effectiveness. I've a feeling this won't be the last time his bravery in the Empire will serve us here in Eorzea.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001880_RAUBAHN
195.description: The threat of an unknown weapon has had us all on edge... But now that we know what we're dealing with, we can take steps to defend against it.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001890_RAUBAHN
196.description: As for Gaius...I'm not sure what to think. Am I happy he's alive? Not in the slightest. Am I happy he's hunting Ascians? Aye. I'd have to say I am.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001900_LYSE
197.description: Oh, speaking of Garleans-you-didn't-expect-to-see, we have a tale of our own, as it happens. When we sent envoys to the imperial army to request talks, they returned with the message that “Varis zos Galvus” would be attending.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001910_HIEN
198.description: The Emperor himself? Well, Varis did sanction the Populares' peace mission...

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001920_HIEN
199.description: ...But knowing that an Ascian walks in his son's skin, I do not see how we can trust him or anyone from that nest of vipers.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001930_RAUBAHN
200.description: The Alliance would proceed with negotiations regardless, if only to give ourselves more time to prepare. We do, however, require your cooperation...

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001940_LYSE
201.description: Ah, right, yes... So...as a condition for the talks to go forward, the Empire has requested that a member of the Scions be present. There'll be a representative from each Alliance nation, of course, but I'm afraid we have to ask that you come along too.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001950_ALISAIE
202.description: Gods, Lyse...you know how much I hate politics. But then what choice do I have? Alphinaud and the others aren't going to do it...

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001960_ALISAIE
203.description: Very well. I shall attend as the Scions' representative.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001970_LYSE
204.description: In case you're wondering why I didn't ask you, the Empire also requested the presence of “Eorzea's champion”...

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
207.description: I'm not fond of politics either...

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001980_LYSE
208.description: That's settled, then. We don't know what Varis means to bring to the table, or why he wants you there, but having you close at hand will make all the difference.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_001990_LYSE
209.description: Oh, you're not, are you? Come on. If Alisaie can put on a brave face, then so can you. Now, we don't know what Varis means to bring to the table, or why he wants you there, but having you close at hand should make all the difference.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002000_RAUBAHN
210.description: The meeting will take place on the border. Anticipating an early assault, we mean to position the bulk of our forces nearby.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002010_LYSE
211.description: The Alliance leaders should already be on their way. Once you're ready, we can head out and join them.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002020_VARIS
212.description: Esteemed representatives of the Eorzean Alliance─on behalf of the Garlean Empire, I thank you for inviting me here today.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002030_VARIS
213.description: As this parley was convened at your request, I invite you to speak first.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002040_NANAMOULNAMO
214.description: Very well, Your Radiance. I, Nanamo Ul Namo, seventeenth in the line of Ul, should be pleased to oblige you.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002050_NANAMOULNAMO
215.description: As recent events in Ala Mhigo and Doma have made plain, the subjugation and exploitation of neighboring nations is not a sustainable policy.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002060_NANAMOULNAMO
216.description: Should this day end in war, you may very well defeat us, but you will never extinguish the people's desire for freedom. Though it may not be in our lifetime, there will be another revolution, another war, and the cycle will continue.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002070_NANAMOULNAMO
217.description: Doma has entered into a concord with the nations of Eorzea. A partnership wherein we recognize one another as equals.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002080_NANAMOULNAMO
218.description: Garlemald could be afforded similar treatment. You need only set aside your ambitions and join us in paving a path towards peace.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002090_VARIS
219.description: Hmph! You will not win me over with sophistry, Your Grace.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002100_VARIS
220.description: As you know only too well, this <hex:021A020203>alliance<hex:021A020103> lacks the strength to keep the peace within its own borders. Even now, your struggles with the beastmen continue unabated.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002110_VARIS
221.description: Divided, you sow this fertile soil with the seeds of your differences and reap naught but discord and chaos for your trouble. Eorzea must be united under one leader, one purpose. I would offer you both and bring an end to your strife.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002120_LYSE
222.description: With all due respect, Your Radiance, the only thing that you offered the people of Ala Mhigo was fear and hopelessness.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002130_HIEN
223.description: The citizens of Doma can also attest to the meager alms of imperial rule. There is no purpose to be found in a life of oppression, each day more uncertain than the last.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002140_LYSE
224.description: Our people are willing to die for their freedom. A great many already have. And countless more will, if we don't put an end to this madness here and now.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002150_VARIS
225.description: We brought order and stability to your lives. This madness and bloodshed is of your own making. You broke the peace, not Garlemald.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002160_RAUBAHN
226.description: Peace? Order? You kill our peoples, despoil our lands, take everything that is ours. And what? You expect us to lick the boot that grinds our faces into the dirt?

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002170_VARIS
227.description: I expect you to weigh the costs. To recognize that countless lives have been lost on both sides in pursuit of a greater good─and to not squander all we have achieved in a fit of petulance.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002180_AYMERIC
228.description: Your Radiance, I fear I can personally attest to the dangers of pursuing one's vision with such righteous fervor.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002190_AYMERIC
229.description: For a thousand years, the Holy See of Ishgard waged war with dragons.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002200_AYMERIC
230.description: A thousand years of sacrifice, of sorrow and hate, in which we bathed in the blood of friend and foe alike. Had it gone on any longer, we may well have drowned.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002210_AYMERIC
231.description: Yet we have chosen to raise ourselves out of this bloody spiral, and have since made peace with our former enemy.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002220_VARIS
232.description: So I understand. No doubt the dragons were more receptive to your overtures in the wake of their leader's demise.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002230_VARIS
233.description: You speak of peace, yet use war to achieve it. Your father would not have bothered to obscure his intent with honeyed words. He understood that strength is all that matters in the end.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002240_VARIS
234.description: Without his clarity of vision, I can but wonder what will become of Ishgard and her people.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002250_VARIS
235.description: There was a time when Garlemald too lacked a leader of conviction. Weak and unable to wield magic, we were at the mercy of the strong, from whom we sought refuge in the bitter cold of the north.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002260_VARIS
236.description: Were it not for the discovery of ceruleum, and the subsequent development of magitek, we might never have gained the power to take back that which was rightfully ours.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002270_MERLWYB
237.description: You speak as if your people were the first to have been driven from their homes. Limsa Lominsa was built by wayward souls in search of a place to call their own.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002280_MERLWYB
238.description: On the shores of Vylbrand we found it, and from those humble beginnings did we grow and flourish. And all without robbing our neighbors of their liberty.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002290_VARIS
239.description: So sayeth the pirate. Am I to believe that you simply asked the kobolds to yield up their lands, and that they were happy to oblige you? That you did not drive them out like rats in the hold of one of the many ships seized by your “privateers”?

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002300_VARIS
240.description: I will concede that, after centuries of exile, reclamation may be mistaken for invasion. Nevertheless, it is not─and those who till stolen soil have no right to object when cast out in turn.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002310_KANESENNA
241.description: Your uncompromising nature rivals that of the Ixal.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002320_KANESENNA
242.description: They too lament circumstances which they themselves perpetuate. Were they but to embrace peace, we would welcome them with open arms. Indeed, some few have done just that, and now receive of the Twelveswood's bounty.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002330_KANESENNA
243.description: Would that your people might learn from their example.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002350_VARIS
245.description: You would dare compare us to the birdmen? You who thought to invoke the Twelve and threaten all of creation?

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002360_VARIS
246.description: I came here in the hope of finding some speck of common ground, but I see now these discussions will accomplish nothing.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002370_VARIS
247.description: Despite what you people may believe, I am not wont to choose the sword over the olive branch. 'Tis but a pity men are loath to accept one without first being shown the other.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002380_ALISAIE
248.description: Wait, I beg you! This meeting was supposed to be a chance to find a way forward together, not to bemoan the missteps which brought us here.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002390_ALISAIE
249.description: Please─if you truly consider violence a last resort, there must be a way we can come to an agreement.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002400_NANAMOULNAMO
250.description: As Mistress Alisaie says, we did not come here to bicker over the past, but to discuss how we might strive towards a brighter future.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002410_NANAMOULNAMO
251.description: Emperor Varis, may I suggest a short recess, that all present might compose themselves prior to beginning anew?

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002420_VARIS
252.description: Very well. I pray this intermission will suffice to move these talks in a more constructive direction.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002430_VARIS
253.description: Now then. Who would have the floor?

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002440_NANAMOULNAMO
254.description: Before we resume, I wish to offer you an apology. After you graciously accepted our invitation to discuss an armistice, we have done naught but rebuke you at every opportunity. I believe I speak for all of us when I say we are deeply sorry for our discourtesy.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002450_MERLWYB
255.description: I'll admit, your familiarity with our affairs surprised me─and served to remind me how little I know of yours.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002460_RAUBAHN
256.description: I think all here can understand the desire to reclaim one's homeland. But why expand further─that is my question.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002470_HIEN
257.description: If I may─the answer can be found in the imperial doctrine they took great pains to impart to my people.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002480_HIEN
258.description: Recognizing the threat eikons pose to the world, Solus zos Galvus decreed that they were to be eradicated. To this end, he began a campaign to unite all lands under the Garlean banner.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002490_HIEN
259.description: Or so we were taught. Yet the Emperor only reached the Burn─the barrens said to have been laid waste by eikons─after conquering all the lands that lay between. What is more, I am quite certain the practice of summoning was not nearly so widespread in the days before the Empire's founding.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002500_LYSE
260.description: When you put it like that, it all starts to sound like an excuse, doesn't it? But to distract from what? Why are you really waging this war?

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002520_VARIS
262.description: I can but hope you heed mine answer and at last accept the righteousness of our cause.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002530_VARIS
263.description: My goal is this: to return the world to the way it once was. The way it was always meant to be.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002540_VARIS
264.description: In doing so, mankind will be made whole once more.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002550_VARIS
265.description: No longer will we suffer from the dissension born of our differences.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002560_VARIS
266.description: There will be but one race─a perfect race─as we were when time began.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002570_LYSE
267.description: What in Rhalgr's name are you talking about?

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002580_VARIS
268.description: I am talking about the origins of this star. Of the Source, and its thirteen reflections.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002590_VARIS
269.description: At the instant of the great sundering, 'twas not only the world that was shattered, but mankind itself. Thus were we divided into myriad races, each with its own unique imperfections.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002600_VARIS
270.description: That is why man looks upon his neighbor and feels fear and hatred. Why he wages war. Why he kills his brother.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002610_VARIS
271.description: You all in your own way have proven as much today. The peace you seek is but a fleeting solution to a fundamental problem. One which calls for more drastic measures.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002620_VARIS
272.description: To bring about everlasting peace, our worlds must be rejoined.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002630_VARIS
273.description: That is the goal the Empire would see realized─the glorious future unto which we shall one day shepherd mankind.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002650_KANESENNA
275.description: I have heard this tale of the Source and its reflections before...

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002660_NANAMOULNAMO
276.description: Are these not the selfsame desires as the Ascians?

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002670_AYMERIC
277.description: Emperor Varis! Do not trust in their words. They will lead you to your doom.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002680_AYMERIC
278.description: My father thought to use them, but in the end he succumbed to their temptations. He embraced summoning like so many other pawns before him. Do not tell us you mean to do the same!

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002700_VARIS
280.description: To be a pawn, free from the burden of choice, would be a blessing...

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002710_VARIS
281.description: But I foreswore that privilege the day I learned that the Garlean Empire was built by the hand of an Ascian.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002730_VARIS
283.description: Yes. My grandsire, the former emperor, is of their number. And who better to build an empire capable of bringing about the calamitous change we desire?

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002740_VARIS
284.description: Would you condemn me for this alliance, for bowing to the will of these shadowy masters, when the prize is true and lasting peace?

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
286.description: Your prize is a lie. Your masters, demons.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
287.description: I will stop you and the Ascians. No matter the cost.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002750_VARIS
288.description: I come not to conquer, but to liberate─to free man from the prison of divergence.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002760_VARIS
289.description: Imagine a world united. One perfect race beneath a single standard.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002770_VARIS
290.description: An army before whose might these servants of Darkness and Light would fly as leaves in a storm, never again to meddle in man's affairs.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002780_VARIS
291.description: We would be the masters of our own fate!

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002790_VARIS
292.description: I bid you join me! Not as subjects of Garlemald, but of a new nation! And together we shall win freedom for ourselves and generations yet unborn!

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002800_LYSE
293.description: You want to trigger another half-dozen calamities? You can't be serious!

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002810_RAUBAHN
294.description: Have you forgotten how many died? There will be no one left!

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002820_MERLWYB
295.description: Do you truly imagine we would aid you in your bloodletting?

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002840_VARIS
297.description: And what is the alternative? To be as cattle waiting for slaughter. I would have us work together, that we might take fate into our own hands.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002860_ALISAIE
299.description: But what of the other worlds, Your Radiance? With every calamity, you obliterate a star and every soul that dwells on it!

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002870_VARIS
300.description: To the Ascians, we are all but tiny, momentary specks within an indifferent universe. We cannot hope to oppose them until we have been made whole once more.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002880_NANAMOULNAMO
301.description: Are these truly the words of Garlemald's ruler?

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002890_NANAMOULNAMO
302.description: The flaws and foibles which you so abhor are what make us who we are. Every nation─even yours, Emperor Varis─is made whole through the combination of these imperfections, the strengths of one compensating for the weaknesses of another.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002900_NANAMOULNAMO
303.description: While it is true that man succumbs all too often to anger and avarice, he may yet overcome his baser instincts through the forming of bonds with others, fostering community and cooperation.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002910_NANAMOULNAMO
304.description: That the protector of an empire should not only reject these fundamental truths, but seek to change them at so dear a cost to life is indefensible.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002920_NANAMOULNAMO
305.description: Such a man is not fit to govern.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002930_VARIS
306.description: And you, Warrior of Light? Would you refuse me as well?

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_A5_000_001_NONE_VOICE
308.description: I cannot condone such a loss of life.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
309.description: We can defeat the Ascians as we are.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002940_NANAMOULNAMO
310.description: It would seem the Alliance is of one mind on this matter.

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002950_VARIS
311.description: You Eorzeans never cease to disappoint me.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002960_VARIS
312.description: Though I suppose I have only myself to blame for expecting more from savages.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002970_VARIS
313.description: This discussion is at an end. I bid you make ready for our next meeting. It will not be at the negotiating table.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002980_LYSE
314.description: I'm not sure what I was expecting from our meeting with the Emperor, but it wasn't that. Still, at least we know now what he's really after!

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_002990_RAUBAHN
315.description: Aye, a future built on a mountain of bodies. I too want the Ascians dead─but not at any cost.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003000_HIEN
316.description: The last of the reinforcements from Doma arrived not long ago. I pray it will be enough. Given the Emperor's stated goal, this is a battle we can ill afford to lose.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003010_RAUBAHN
317.description: If the Garleans come in force, we may not have much say in the matter...even with our combined strength.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003020_HIEN
318.description: We knew from the first that the odds would be against us. But if there is even the slightest chance of victory, we must do everything in our power to seize it.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003030_RAUBAHN
319.description: We must seize it, full stop.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003050_RAUBAHN
321.description: The two of you are to join an irregular unit and support the main host. I won't bother asking if you're minded to fight.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003060_ALISAIE
322.description: After coming this far, how could I not?

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003070_ALISAIE
323.description: And for once, there's no one around to countermand me. Not that they would. Not even my brother.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003080_ALISAIE
324.description: But we all know who'll really make the difference. Ready to frighten some Garleans?

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003090_RAUBAHN
325.description: I wouldn't want to be on their side.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003100_HIEN
326.description: Might I ask you to accompany the Doman contingent? They are strangers here, and your presence would do much to raise their spirits.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003120_YUGIRI
328.description: When our people stride out with you in their midst, I daresay the Eorzeans will feel an ilm taller themselves. High spirits have a way of spreading.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003130_RAUBAHN
329.description: Ah, what I wouldn't give to join you. But my duties as field commander will not allow it. I leave the front lines in your capable hands.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003140_RAUBAHN
330.description: Comrades! Ready your arms! The hour of battle has come!

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003150_RAUBAHN
331.description: May the Crystal guide us to victory!

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003160_ALISAIE
332.description: Since the others couldn't be here, we'll have to fight twice as hard. If Alphinaud wakes to find the imperials have won, I shall never hear the end of it.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003170_ALISAIE
333.description: It's strange... I thought I would be terrified when the fighting started.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003180_ALISAIE
334.description: I <hex:021A020203>should<hex:021A020103> be terrified. But with you at our side, I can't help feeling everything is going to be all right.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003200_ALISAIE
336.description: Don't you dare leave me alone.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003201_ALISAIE
337.description: No matter what happens, we have to survive. Together.

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003210_ALISAIE
338.description: We did it! I daresay they'll be reeling from this!

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003220_HIEN
339.description: You were truly inspiring in battle, my friend. I'm determined not to be outdone, but there seems to be no one left to fight...

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003240_ALISAIE
341.description: We should give chase. Finish them off while we have the chance.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003250_ALISAIE
342.description: Imagine the others' surprise when they wake to find the war already won.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04500_003320_HIEN
349.description: Quickly! We must get her back to the encampment.
